name: Influencer Outreach Pipeline

nodes.name: Daily Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs discovery once a day. Swap for a webhook trigger if you want on-demand runs instead.

nodes.name: Run Discovery
nodes.notes: Calls a small Flask/FastAPI wrapper around discovery.py + filter_classify.py + enrich.py, returns the qualified+enriched list as JSON.

nodes.name: Filter: Follower Range
nodes.notes: Mirrors filter_classify.py thresholds. Kept here too so non-engineers can tweak the number in the n8n UI without touching code.

nodes.name: Generate Messages (LLM)
nodes.notes: Wraps personalize.py - calls Claude/GPT with the influencer's niche + content theme, returns email_pitch + instagram_dm.

parameters.subject: Collab idea for {{$json["name"]}} x Voltura Fit

nodes.name: Send Email
nodes.notes: Gmail/SMTP node. In the Python version this is sending.py's _send_smtp().

nodes.name: Log to Tracker Sheet
nodes.notes: Same role as sending.py writing to outreach_tracker.csv / outreach.db - one row per attempt, sent or skipped, with a reason.

parameters.content: Instagram DMs: not auto-sent (Meta doesn't allow bulk automated DM outreach through any public API). This branch just logs the generated DM copy to the tracker for manual sending.

_notes: This is a reference workflow, not a running deployment - I don't have an n8n instance or hosted API wrapper set up in this environment. It maps 1:1 onto the Python pipeline (main.py) so it's clear how this would move into a no-code automation tool: discover -> filter -> personalize -> branch on email availability -> send -> log. Import into n8n and point the HTTP Request nodes at a real API wrapper around discovery.py/personalize.py to make it live.
